speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Lower turbine installations have been completed and are significantly reducing bird collision risk.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: From a conservation perspective, this measure provides a strong improvement in alignment with SDG 15 objectives.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: However, lowering turbine height has reduced overall energy efficiency across the wind farm.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: Maintaining output may require future expansion or additional infrastructure investments.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD REPRESENTATIVE
text: Any expansion into adjacent coastal zones would overlap with fishing grounds and threaten local livelihoods and food security.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD REPRESENTATIVE
text: We strongly oppose any further industrial expansion into these waters.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: This situation highlights a conflict between biodiversity protection (SDG 15), economic livelihoods (SDG 8), and food system stability (SDGs 1 and 2).

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: All implementation outcomes have been recorded. The Cabinet will now proceed to the final integrated evaluation.
